verdict.rationale: Kong documents its own management API for AI Gateway in Konnect (e.g. a list-ai-gateways endpoint) and an official CLI, kongctl, that manages resources declaratively as code and imperatively for one-off operations. Nothing in the evidence states that every UI action has an API equivalent, so parity with the UI is unproven. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of all entities and analytics features, and independent hands-on corroboration that API-only workflows are complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: list-ai-gateways summary: List AI Gateways description: Returns a list of AI Gateways in the organization.
It supports two modes of operation: declarative configuration for managing resources as code, and imperative commands for one-off operations and inspection.
